scripts.dev: npm run build -w @mums-bookshelf/shared && concurrently -n web,api -c magenta,cyan "npm run dev -w @mums-bookshelf/web" "npm run dev -w @mums-bookshelf/api"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @mums-bookshelf/shared && npm run build -w @mums-bookshelf/api && npm run build -w @mums-bookshelf/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @mums-bookshelf/shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build -w @mums-bookshelf/shared && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test:coverage: npm run build -w @mums-bookshelf/shared && npm run test:coverage --workspaces --if-present
